objective: Close the reflection-probe blind spot left by the new manufacturing-scale Danchi detail UV system. Formal MainCamera pre-cull already validates metric UV meshes before still/temporal frames, but ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe does not invoke that callback; therefore stale normalized UVs, wrong per-piece phase identities or drifted six-material texture transforms could otherwise seed a realtime cubemap before the still-frame guard rejects them.

changes.summary: Adds a machine-readable fail-closed contract requiring manufacturing-scale detail-UV validation before every reflection-lighting fingerprint boundary: pre-RenderProbe request, every observed Editor poll, completion and immediate pre-still. It maps only to obvious_repetition and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer risk reduction, awards zero Visual Fidelity points and keeps readiness at 93.

Adds source/runtime contract validation and a report-free reflection-path scene check. The scene check delegates to QualityBlockDetailPhysicalUvQA.ValidateOpenScene(false), covering the DanchiHighDetail manifest, minimum source renderer/phase diversity, all six canonical material transforms, persisted physical-UV mesh identities, UV/tangent completeness and deterministic phase tokens without performing deep per-edge geometry work on every poll.

Chains the new physical-UV contract into the existing reflection material binding that is already called by QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint. This makes the established async reflection request/poll/completion/pre-still path fail closed for invalid detail UV state and also makes the new contract reachable transitively from core Visual Fidelity Gate Integrity.

reasoning.whyThisTaskNow: The immediately preceding run made detail microstructure metric and phase-diverse, but its strongest runtime guard was Camera.onPreCull. Realtime reflection probes are independent cameras and do not pass through that formal MainCamera callback. Because metal/roughness microstructure is visible through reflection response, allowing a cubemap to be generated from a stale UV state would undermine both repetition and grazing-light evidence even if the subsequent still itself used valid UVs.
reasoning.whyNoNewAssetExpansion: With no Runner or sealed pixels available, another speculative asset would not be scoreable. Closing a known evidence-state inconsistency protects future Material/PBR, Texture/Microdetail and Temporal judgments without pretending that source validation is image quality.
reasoning.validationDepth: Reflection polling uses the lightweight physical-UV scene validator rather than the deep chamfer-edge metric-isometry pass. The lightweight path still verifies every active source renderer binding, persisted generated mesh identity, complete UV/tangent data, phase token, material transform, minimum phase diversity and all six canonical materials. Deep edge isometry remains part of explicit prepared-scene validation and need not be recomputed on every asynchronous probe poll.
reasoning.pixelAuthority: The new binding cannot establish that texture repetition is visually imperceptible or that normal maps are temporally stable. grazing/material_grazing, grazing/sash_rail_response and oblique/balcony_services at native 100% remain authoritative.

selfAudit: The existing reflection-lighting fingerprint was re-read before editing. It calls QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA.ValidateOpenScene before computing the fingerprint, and that fingerprint is the state used by the established request/poll/completion/pre-still synchronization path. The new UV check therefore reuses an existing formal synchronization choke point rather than creating a parallel probe lifecycle.

QualityBlockDetailPhysicalUvQA.ValidateOpenScene(false) was confirmed public and report-free. In the formal fingerprint path the benchmark scene is already required to be open; the delegated lightweight validator does not generate evidence reports, save assets or alter UV data.

Core QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA was re-read and confirmed to invoke QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA.ValidateContractConfigOnly. Because that method now invokes QualityBlockReflectionDetailPhysicalUvBindingQA.ValidateContractConfigOnly, weakening or deleting the new machine-readable UV binding contract prevents the core source-side gate-integrity check from succeeding.
The new critical-risk IDs are exactly the canonical gate IDs obvious_repetition and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer. No alias vocabulary was introduced.
No Visual Fidelity category score was changed. Source coherence reduces future evidence risk but does not prove a rendered pixel or clear a critical defect.
The substantive compare from startHead to substantiveWorkHead is 3 commits ahead / 0 behind with merge-base equal to startHead; all changed files are under UnityProject/.

readiness.reasonReadinessNotRaised: The remaining seven readiness points remain reserved for real Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime, generated physical-UV asset observation and native evidence. Adding a source-side reflection binding cannot substitute for Runner verification.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded: Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: protects future evidence from a probe/still mismatch where metric UV and phase diversity are valid only at still time.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: protects reflection response from being generated with stale microstructure placement before the still is captured.
Critical obvious_repetition risk: reduced source-side evidence risk because a stale normalized or wrong-phase Danchi detail state now aborts before formal reflection synchronization.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: reduced evidence-integrity risk only; actual shimmer, moire and LOD behavior remain native-pixel judgments.
No category receives numeric Visual Fidelity points without sealed native 3840x2160 evidence.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/Editor execution. On first Runner, stop speculative expansion; confirm compilation, run the normal prepared-scene chain, verify persisted physical-UV meshes and phase diversity, then start formal reflection synchronization and prove that the new UV guard passes before RenderProbe and remains stable through observed polls/completion/pre-still. After that, seal hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 frames and inspect the three required 100% crops for repetition, wrong grain direction, cylinder seams, bevel stretch and shimmer before assigning any Visual Fidelity score.
